I'm planning to construct three similar puzzle inputs with vertical grippers, varying the colors and piece shapes for each pair while keeping the mirroring structure around the bar column.

For pair 1, I'll place a left bar with lips at fixed rows, then define a small piece cluster on the left that mirrors across the bar into corresponding cells on the interior side.

For pair 2, I'll rotate the gripper to horizontal orientation with bar rows and lips positioned symmetrically, placing pieces above and below that mirror across the bar row. Pair 3 will reuse the vertical gripper setup at a smaller grid size with different colors for variety.
